  - Udon noodles: 1 package Sanuki-style udon noodles.
  - Toppings: 1/2 pound sliced pork, 1/2 cup sliced green onions, 1/2 cup shredded daikon radish, 1/4 cup grated ginger, boiled egg, shichimi togarashi (optional).
